requirement:
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
of the supplied contents under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.sources.provider_observations`. Direct tracked reads
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
Failures record no successful observation.

The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation of `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`. I judged this from the supplied test sources and did not read any implementation source.

**Successful read records the mapped node identity and the fingerprint of the supplied contents.**
- `src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns]` asserts that the dependency is exactly `Dependency::Node(intern_node("source-node"), returned.fingerprint())`. It also asserts that the domain read the "source-node" node.
- `fn[deterministic_source_reads_reuse_saved_results]` asserts the recorded dependency equals `Content::Text("first").fingerprint()`.
- The agent-side tests assert the exact fingerprint of the delivered contents. They are `src/agent/tests.rs#fn[cached_selected_source_reads_record_exact_delivered_contents_and_errors_add_no_input]`, `#fn[source_tools_forward_arguments_and_present_discovery_and_read_results]` (empty, absent, and `fn[chosen]` selectors) and `#fn[source_tools_keep_search_discovery_separate_from_delivered_source_reads]`.

**Direct reads record on return, and agent reads record on delivery.**
- The direct test checks that the dependencies are empty before the successful read and hold one entry afterwards.
- `fn[source_read_pages_retain_text_and_dependencies_without_another_read]` checks that the dependency is attached at page delivery (`get_next_page`). It also checks that the observation callback runs only once and that the recorded fingerprint is the original snapshot, even though the file changed afterwards.
- `fn[source_tools_keep_search_discovery_separate_from_delivered_source_reads]` checks that search discovery adds no dependency. A search followed by a delivered read leaves exactly one dependency.
- `fn[search_excerpts_redact_credentials_before_serialization_and_paging]` checks that search results carry no dependencies and the domain is never read, while the later `finish_search` selection does record a dependency.

**Failures record no successful observation.**
- The direct test covers an unknown resource and an unknown selector, both rejected by the mapping with "unsupported source item". It also covers a domain read failure (`fail_read`). In each case it asserts that `dependencies()` is empty.
- In the unknown-resource and unknown-selector cases it asserts the domain's read counter and `read_nodes` stay empty.
- In the cached agent test, `read_source` of `fn[missing]` errors and the final dependency list is still exactly one entry.

**The dependency becomes stale when the node's fingerprint changes.**
- The direct test finishes the record, asserts it is current, changes the text, and asserts it is no longer current.
- `fn[source_reads_track_optional_dependencies_and_empty_searches_remain_discovery]` does the same through the agent path. It asserts staleness only when a dependency was recorded, which also covers the no-dependency case.
- `fn[deterministic_source_reads_reuse_saved_results]` checks that a changed domain text produces new output.

**The standalone outline parser records no graph dependency.**
- In `fn[source_reads_track_optional_dependencies_and_empty_searches_remain_discovery]`, calling `analysis.parse` directly leaves `ctx.dependencies()` empty and the observation count at 0.
- `outline_source` deliveries carry no dependencies, and no observation callback is invoked before `read_source`. Both are asserted in `fn[source_tools_forward_arguments_and_present_discovery_and_read_results]`.

**The mapping cannot return an untracked successful read.** I read this as a structural property of the API. The direct test shows that every successful read returned through `read_source` is recorded.

I found no unmarked relevant tests and no acknowledged gaps.
